systems.system: Open Data Kit (ODK) real-time data collection and geospatial tracking, measles-rubella vaccination campaign
systems.platform: Open Data Kit (ODK) on mobile devices, with interactive dashboards and geospatial maps designed with the WHO AFRO GIS Centre
systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de la Protection sociale, Programme élargi de vaccination (PEV), with WHO technical and financial support and Gavi funds
systems.tiers: campaign agents (more than 612 trained, community health workers among them) on Ndzuwani, Ngazidja and Mwali, 4 to 8 October 2025; dashboards from community level to national; no facility tier stated

note: No fact: the only system is a data collection tool for one national vaccination campaign, the first to replace paper forms; it is neither routine facility reporting nor a patient record.
